item.description:
### Added - **Policy Simulator, admin ranking:** when admin ranking is on in ZIA, the simulator now evaluates ZIA rules by admin rank first (0 is highest), then by rule order, as ZIA does. Each rule shows its rank, and the result says when rank put a rule with a lower order number behind the deciding rule, and whether that rule would otherwise have decided. Loading a tenant's policy also reads whether admin ranking is on; snapshots saved before this version are treated as off. - **Policy Simulator, Block it / allow it:** with admin ranking on, a new rule gets the admin rank of the rule it goes above (at the top, the first rule's), and the preview warns that the API client's admin role needs that rank to save it. - **Prove it:** also reads whether admin ranking is on, so its verdicts match the Policy Simulator's, and says when it couldn't read it.
### Fixed - **Policy Simulator, Block it / allow it:** a snapshot file with a rule whose order is out of range no longer makes the preview quit the app.
